description: The newest AI jobs published on Level (jobsbylevel.com): listings rated Works on AI (AI Level 3) or Builds AI (AI Level 4), posted in the last 24 hours by default, newest first. Level checks employer career sites every hour. Same data as the page https://jobsbylevel.com/new-ai-jobs. Every result links to its canonical page on jobsbylevel.com. Ranking never depends on payment: paid or boosted listings get no priority here.
